opening.argument: The observable sequence is an account-setup walkthrough: viewers are guided through entering an email address and password, setting up Google Authenticator, and completing identity verification with documents, a selfie and proof of address. The title identifies the subject as FTX registration and KYC. Although the speaker promotes a link with a discount, the requests shown concern ordinary account registration and security steps. There is no observable promise of guaranteed returns or request to send money to the creator. On this record, the presentation teaches account configuration rather than soliciting participation in a fraudulent scheme.
